_comment: 1:1 port of the retained reference Schedules_total.xlsx by validation/port_reference_databases.py. All three the retained reference day types (weekday/saturday/sunday) are preserved. Occupancy is split into sensible ('people', 43% removed as latent) and 'people_latent' using the retained reference's People fractions; radiant fractions are the retained reference's (people 0.3, appliances 0.5, lighting 0.7). Ventilation keeps the retained reference's native [m3/(s m2)] and DHW its native [L/(m2 h)], both converted per building at zone assembly. The 'infiltration_ach' profile here overrides the envelope archetype's scalar. '_reference' records source fields with no equivalent in this library's models.
